documentation.file_docstring:
Delta Audit Engine — tamper-evident append-only audit log.

Records VFS state changes as a SHA-256 hash chain where each entry
links to its predecessor, providing cryptographic tamper evidence.
member_docstrings: VFSChange: A single change within a delta.
SemanticDelta: A delta capturing VFS state changes at a single turn.
DeltaEngine: Tamper-evident append-only audit log with SHA-256 hash chain verification.
compute_hash: Compute SHA-256 hash covering all fields including changes and parent linkage.
verify_hash: Recompute hash and compare to stored value without mutation.
capture: Capture a delta for a turn, chaining to previous entry.
compute_hash_chain_root: Return hash of last delta in the chain.
verify_chain: Verify full chain integrity: hash correctness and parent linkage.
